tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches the gray zone at s_grad = 2.44 but never crosses the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. The targeted high-gradient probe can distinguish continued smooth saturation from a threshold-driven drop.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A smooth pilot fit cannot rule out an avalanche above the observed gradient range.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter threshold-avalanche model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot gradients are below the proposed threshold range, so the threshold and avalanche strength are unidentifiable.
It costs more and does not directly target the missing high-gradient regime.
